name: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER)
evidence: The official About Us page states that the Government of India declared NIPER an "Institute of National Importance" and that it is an autonomous body under the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Government of India.
notes: Normal TLS verification failed with the exact proxy certificate error "self signed certificate in certificate chain"; used curl --insecure only for public GET requests to www.niper.gov.in.
